description: MRF Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of rubber products in India and internationally. The company provides tires for passenger cars, two wheelers, fighter aircraft, farm, trucks, OTR, SCV, LCV, pick up, three wheeler, MCV, ICV, and tubes and valves products; rubber products, such as tubes, flaps, and tread rubber products; and manufactures specialty coatings. It also involved in the paints and coats, sports goods, and motorsports businesses.
